events.text:
I built the Day-1 dry-run as one command, `workshop-plan/ops/dryrun_day1.py`, and a full run with all three personas passed (with stand-ins for the unbuilt stages). T-034 stays blocked until T-031, T-032 and T-033 are built, and none of that needs anything from Adi.

**What a run does:** it adds the three personas from `build/questions.py` (SendFlow, Apex Growth, Sarah Chen) to the local centre as "Adi test" test attendees, on growthcluborg+sendflow / +apex / +sarah @gmail.com. Each posts its Day 1 answers to `POST /api/survey`, and the harness times submit to delivery for each one. The times go into a results table in the new `workshop-plan/ops/runbook.md`, which T-006 still has to fill out with the rest of the runbook. Afterwards it tags the attendees test and revokes them through the centre's admin API, never by hand.

**Stand-ins:** the day output, the PDF and link, and the email and WhatsApp send don't exist yet, so the harness covers each one:
- a simple HTML page built from the answers;
- a PDF rendered with Playwright, with a local file link;
- a Tantra campaign on the vendor simulator whose email and WhatsApp messages carry that link.

Each stage switches to the real one as soon as it writes the expected `day_outputs` table in `ops.db` (the columns are listed in the runbook).

**What I checked:** the run took 0.4 to 0.6 seconds per persona, all on stand-ins, so those times say nothing about real delivery. The centre logged the three survey saves, the three PDFs are valid, and the attendees ended up test and revoked. `--require-real` correctly refuses to run today.

**Not pushed:** it's committed locally (d8153bf). Pushing `main` would also publish 30 other commits, mostly other sessions' work, which is more than the approved push of the harness and runbook.

**Next step:** once T-031 to T-033 write to that table, run `python3 workshop-plan/ops/dryrun_day1.py --require-real` to record the real timings and close T-034.

I acknowledged note F-5fac6881. The results from today's run are in `[redacted].json`.
